name: ArithmeticThetaActualLevelR0208.AnchoredMap
docstring: A classifying map with an actual family isomorphism at its identity test.

name: ArithmeticThetaActualLevelR0208.FiberPresentation
docstring: Representability on all field-base tests, with both projections and naturality.

name: ArithmeticThetaActualLevelR0208.PullbackComparison
docstring:
Actual family/root comparison, natural in every test morphism and normalized
at identity. Its arrows retain the marked curve, cotangent and full square map.

name: ArithmeticThetaActualLevelR0208.TestFiber
docstring: All arrows in the categorical fiber of actual family maps over Spec k.

name: ArithmeticThetaArithmeticFieldR0231.integralTheta
docstring: The integer shell-count series, before any coefficient-field embedding.

name: ArithmeticThetaBoundaryHodgeR0182.Normalized
docstring:
The actual differential dx/(2y) on the fixed Tate cubic, normalized on
its specified affine chart. The accepted global-frame provider supplies it.

name: ArithmeticThetaCommonHalfHodgeR0185.along
docstring: Canonical comparison over a specified commuting triangle.

name: ArithmeticThetaCompactifiedDifferentialR0145.relativeD
docstring: Universal relative derivation for the particular structural ring map.

name: ArithmeticThetaConservativeKernelR0189.CutoffSpecification
docstring:
The conservative bound, including its rank-zero case and exact rational value.
`Indexing`, `Indexed` and `FormalIdentity` retain the actual unary factorization
and its complete formal-series identity.

name: ArithmeticThetaConservativeKernelR0189.PrefixDeterminesKernel
docstring: The coefficient prefix through `B` detects every full-series relation.

name: ArithmeticThetaConservativeKernelR0189.cutoff
docstring:
Exact integer realization of n*K^s*I(L)/48. The final theorem must prove
its equality to the displayed rational source expression.

name: ArithmeticThetaCoverComparison.tensorPowerMap
docstring: The actual functorial morphism on the established sheaf tensor powers.

name: ArithmeticThetaCubicModelR0144.rootSeries
docstring: The actual three marked coordinate values for Q=t^r and even r.

name: ArithmeticThetaCyclotomicModularityR0239.CoefficientField
docstring:
The concrete number field `ℚ(ζ_L)`, with `L = coefficientLevel A`.
This abbreviation retains the prescribed field; it does not choose an arbitrary
field or discard the dependence on the lattice family.

name: ArithmeticThetaCyclotomicModularityR0239.coefficientLevel
docstring: Prescribed level obtained from the common unary denominator of the family.

name: ArithmeticThetaDegreeAssembly.CertifiedImageData
docstring:
Full kernel basis, full image basis and unique rational reconstruction.
This is an abbreviation of three explicit conclusions, with no added assumption.

name: ArithmeticThetaDegreeAssembly.ImageBasisCorrect
docstring: The selected complete theta series form a basis of the theta image.

name: ArithmeticThetaDegreeAssembly.ReconstructionCorrect
docstring: Every input series has the computed coordinates, uniquely over `ℚ`.

name: ArithmeticThetaDegreeAssembly.RelationBasisCorrect
docstring: The computed nullspace vectors form a basis of all complex theta relations.

name: ArithmeticThetaDegreeAssembly.imageBasis
docstring: The original complete theta series selected by the pivot columns.

name: ArithmeticThetaDegreeAssembly.imageCombination
docstring: A rational linear combination of the selected complete theta series.

name: ArithmeticThetaDegreeAssembly.imageDimension
docstring: Number of selected theta series (the number of pivot columns).

name: ArithmeticThetaDegreeAssembly.reconstructionCoordinates
docstring: Rational reconstruction coordinates supplied by the same elimination.

name: ArithmeticThetaDegreeAssembly.relationBasis
docstring: The computed rational nullspace basis, viewed as vectors over `ℂ`.

name: ArithmeticThetaDegreeAssembly.relationCount
docstring: Number of rational nullspace vectors computed from coefficients through `B`.

name: ArithmeticThetaFieldImageR0233.SectionImage
docstring:
Exact relations, independence, spanning and rational coordinates of actual
sections. No freely chosen k-module action is used on their carrier.

name: ArithmeticThetaFullLevelCoverR0175.FullLevel
docstring:
Two killed sections whose nonzero residue combinations avoid the actual
identity subscheme. The test scheme may be nonreduced or disconnected.

name: ArithmeticThetaLatticeSectionsR0188.Indexing
docstring: Enumerate the distinct pairs actually used by the chosen preimage cosets.

name: ArithmeticThetaLatticeSectionsR0188.baseScalar
docstring: Scalars on the actual curve use its displayed structure morphism.

name: ArithmeticThetaLatticeSectionsR0188.expanded
docstring: Literal q=t^(24*N^2) substitution; no chosen series functional.

name: ArithmeticThetaLegendreAtlasR0176.EllipticFamily
docstring:
A genuine elliptic family over the quotient ring. The law is on all
scheme-valued points, and smoothness/properness concern its actual structure map.

name: ArithmeticThetaLevelCount.levelIndex
docstring: The rational product occurring in the manuscript, with no cardinality assumption.

name: ArithmeticThetaLocalWeierstrassR0203.Family
docstring: A smooth proper one-dimensional commutative group scheme with connected fibres.

name: ArithmeticThetaLocalWeierstrassR0203.SchemeLaw
docstring: A natural commutative group law on all scheme-valued points over any base.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticComparisonR0206.ActualGroupoidProof.backward
docstring: The uniquely inclusion-normalized backward cotangent comparison.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticComparisonR0206.ActualPullbackProof.Lift
docstring: A chosen Cartesian family, retaining the actual pullback line.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticComparisonR0206.ActualPullbackProof.arrow
docstring: The line arrow is the actual sheaf pullback and obeys the exact square.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticComparisonR0206.ActualPullbackProof.curveMap
docstring: Universal-property lift of a curve arrow.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticComparisonR0206.ActualPullbackProof.pullData
docstring: The simultaneous curve, canonical cotangent, and line comparisons.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticComparisonR0206.Arrow
docstring:
Actual isomorphisms, including the inclusion-normalized cotangent map.
The cotangent map points forward, the inverse of differential pullback.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticComparisonR0206.GroupoidData
docstring:
The category must have exactly these arrows, and the actual curve/line
composition laws. This is construction output, not an input category of classes.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticComparisonR0206.Object
docstring:
An arbitrary marked elliptic family and a root of its ACTUAL cotangent.
There is no chosen classifier, equation, frame or Hodge comparison in this input.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticComparisonR0206.PullbackData
docstring:
A functorial pullback of the actual families with their actual roots.
Both curve and line squares commute for every arrow, not only geometric points.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticStackR0207.Coherence
docstring:
Actual unit and composition isomorphisms with pentagon and both triangle
laws. These are required outputs, not hypotheses of the construction theorem.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticStackR0207.Coherence.functor
docstring: Standard categorical packaging of the required coherence laws.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticStackR0207.CompNormalized
docstring:
Both geometric components of composition are fixed, including the original
Cartesion projections and the canonical sheaf pullback associativity map.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticStackR0207.ForgetData
docstring:
A coherent tautological line, with the specified actual pullback map.
HEq only compares the dependent functor hom types after app_eq; it does not
weaken either map or permit an arbitrary scalar.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticStackR0207.UnitNormalized
docstring: Both geometric components of the unit comparison are fixed.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticStackR0207.group
docstring: Fix already constructed actual groupoids, without changing their objects or arrows.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticStackR0207.linePull
docstring: The already proved line-naturality equation, presented as a natural iso.

name: ArithmeticThetaMetaplecticStackR0207.pull
docstring: Use the accepted geometric pullback and all its curve, cotangent and line equations.

name: ArithmeticThetaNormalizedSections.pullbackPowerSection
docstring: Pullback of a power section via the accepted genuine tensor comparison.

name: ArithmeticThetaOpenHodgeR0180.Test
docstring:
A genuine pointed Cartesian Weierstrass comparison, including the actual
multiplication maps. No section or expansion equality is an input.

name: ArithmeticThetaOpenHodgeR0180.comparison
docstring: Reuse the accepted general pointed differential comparison.

name: ArithmeticThetaPullback.presheafAdjunction
docstring: The actual presheaf pullback/pushforward adjunction, with its scheme types exposed.

name: ArithmeticThetaPullback.presheafPullback
docstring: Presheaf pullback with scheme-specific source and target types exposed.

name: ArithmeticThetaPullback.presheafPullbackTensorIso
docstring: The canonical tensor comparison for actual module presheaves.

name: ArithmeticThetaPullback.presheafPullbackTensorMap
docstring: The tensor comparison of presheaf pullback, adjoint to the pure-section pairing.

name: ArithmeticThetaPullback.presheafPushforward
docstring: Presheaf pushforward with scheme-specific source and target types exposed.

name: ArithmeticThetaPullback.presheafPushforwardTensorMap
docstring: The ordinary sectionwise tensor pairing for pushforward of module presheaves.

name: ArithmeticThetaPullback.pullbackGlobalSection
docstring:
The global section map induced by the actual pullback/pushforward adjunction.
It is only an ordinary definition; the compatibility laws are target obligations.

name: ArithmeticThetaPullback.pullback_sheafTensor_iso
docstring:
Canonical pullback comparison for genuine sheaf tensors. The construction uses
commutation of pullback with sheafification, the colimit-preserving presheaf comparison,
and descent of tensor pairings through sheafification.

name: ArithmeticThetaPullback.pullback_tensorPower_iso
docstring:
Recursive comparison for every genuine tensor power, including the structure
sheaf at exponent zero.

name: ArithmeticThetaPullback.pullback_unit_iso
docstring:
The canonical structure-sheaf comparison for the actual pullback functor.
Its forward map is adjoint to the structure-sheaf morphism of `p`.

name: ArithmeticThetaPullback.sheafTensorCongr
docstring: The genuine sheaf tensor transports isomorphisms in both factors.

name: ArithmeticThetaPullback.sheafTensorMap
docstring: Functoriality of the genuine sheaf tensor, induced by sheafification.

name: ArithmeticThetaPullback.sheafificationTensorIso
docstring:
Sheafification commutes with the genuine sheaf tensor. Both unit maps are
inverted using descent into arbitrary target module sheaves.

name: ArithmeticThetaRelativeDiscriminantR0171.HodgeBaseChange.differentialMap
docstring: The morphism induced by the actual square on relative differential sheaves.

name: ArithmeticThetaRelativeDiscriminantR0171.HodgeBaseChange.pointedDifferentialIso
docstring: Pullback of the actual Cartesian differential comparison to the pointed sections.

name: ArithmeticThetaRelativeDiscriminantR0171.HodgeBaseChange.squarePullbackIso
docstring: The comparison for pullbacks along the two sides of a commutative square.

name: ArithmeticThetaRelativeDiscriminantR0171.IsFrame
docstring: A section generates the actual sheaf on every subopen, including empty opens.

name: ArithmeticThetaReview.Geometry.CompactCurve
docstring:
A compact curve, its half-weight line, and the actual finite level on a
dense open. The line on the level is literally the restriction of this line,
not an unrelated line with an arbitrarily chosen expansion map.

name: ArithmeticThetaReview.Geometry.FiniteLevel
docstring:
Every base change to a scheme is represented by a finite étale scheme.
The bound concerns the actual projection to that test scheme; zero rank on
other components is allowed. Both projections and naturality are retained by
`FiberPresentation`. This predicate makes no reference to an atlas/provider.

name: ArithmeticThetaReview.Geometry.FramedFamily
docstring:
A specified dominant formal disk and its genuine line-bundle frame.
These are geometric pullbacks and global sections, not abstract linear
functionals. The normalization bridge identifies the original Tate frame.

name: ArithmeticThetaReview.Geometry.Realizes
docstring:
Complete theta expansions in the displayed frame, with the literal
substitution `q = t^L` and the scalar action of the actual structure morphism.

name: ArithmeticThetaReview.Normalization.CanonicalCotangent
docstring:
The affine Hodge-to-cotangent comparison is fixed by the actual conormal
map and the identity-ideal inclusion. This is the original classifier equation
with only its family and maps as parameters.

name: ArithmeticThetaReview.Normalization.FrameNormalization
docstring:
All Tate normalization data for one framed compact family. The interior
root, compact square, and disk frame are linked in the same record.

name: ArithmeticThetaReview.Normalization.InteriorLink
docstring:
The metaplectic family's marked curve and root square are the restrictions
of this very compact square. The equality of root lines fixes the transport in
the final equation; no independent square root or scalar comparison is chosen.

name: ArithmeticThetaReview.Normalization.NormalizedFrame
docstring:
The square of the actual half-weight frame is a regular Hodge generator,
whose punctured value is the prescribed normalized Tate differential.

name: ArithmeticThetaReview.Normalization.TateChart
docstring:
A marked Tate test of the actual open Hodge line and its extension to a
disk on a compact target. The period is the one in `TateCurve k L`, namely t^L.
The prescribed differential satisfies dx = (2y) delta on the fixed Tate chart.

name: ArithmeticThetaReview.Normalization.TateChart.comparison
docstring:
Canonical comparison obtained by composing the actual pullback maps and
the pointed differential comparison of the displayed Cartesian Tate test.

name: ArithmeticThetaReview.Normalization.restrictedSquare
docstring:
Restriction of a specified compact square map along the actual open
triangle, followed by the displayed open Hodge comparison.

name: ArithmeticThetaReview.Normalization.schemeFamily
docstring:
The general-scheme view of an affine elliptic family uses precisely the
same curve, structure map, group operations and geometric properties.

name: ArithmeticThetaRootStackR0198.modulesOver
docstring: The actual sheaf pullback pseudofunctor on schemes over B.

name: ArithmeticThetaRootStackR0198.rootTopology
docstring: The standard big fpqc topology on schemes over the specified base.

name: ArithmeticThetaSchemeHodgeR0205.Cotangent
docstring: The actual conormal I/I² at the identity, expressed as e*I.

name: ArithmeticThetaSchemeHodgeR0205.CotangentCompatible
docstring:
Canonical cotangent comparison: the witnessing ideal isomorphism preserves
its actual ideal inclusion; no arbitrary line is chosen.

name: ArithmeticThetaSchemeHodgeR0205.IdealCompatible
docstring: Compatibility with the inclusion of the actual identity ideal in O.

name: ArithmeticThetaSchemeHodgeR0205.affineDifferential
docstring:
On an affine base use the accepted canonical derivative, including its
normalization on every ideal section.

name: ArithmeticThetaSchemeHodgeR0205.cotangentComparison
docstring: The comparison is induced by the actual ideal comparison and pointed square.

name: ArithmeticThetaSchemeLevelR0204.FullLevel
docstring: A full ordered marking, tested on the actual identity subscheme.

name: ArithmeticThetaSchemeLevelR0204.Multiplicative
docstring: Compatibility with multiplication on every actual scheme-valued point.

name: ArithmeticThetaSharpKernelR0195.cutoff
docstring: Natural division is the exact nonnegative floor, with no enlarged cutoff.

name: ArithmeticThetaSheafTensor.sheafTensor
docstring: The actual sheafification of the actual categorical tensor of module presheaves.

name: ArithmeticThetaSimultaneousUnaryR0187.squareOnDisk
docstring: Pull back the specific square map and the same commuting triangle.

name: ArithmeticThetaSimultaneousUnaryR0187.unarySeries
docstring: The actual integral unary series, before the accepted Laurent inclusion.

name: ArithmeticThetaSquareLinesR0192.SquareLine
docstring: A genuine invertible sheaf with its specified square isomorphism.

name: ArithmeticThetaSquareLinesR0192.squarePull
docstring: Pullback retains the supplied square map and the canonical tensor comparison.

name: ArithmeticThetaStackLevelR0199.Points
docstring: A universe lift of the discrete functor of points; arrows remain small.

name: ArithmeticThetaStackLevelR0199.pointsFunctor
docstring: The representable presheaf as a category-valued functor.

name: ArithmeticThetaTateCuspsR0181.TateLevel
docstring: Full marking on the specific split cubic for period q=t^L.

name: ArithmeticThetaTateSeries.monomial
docstring: a*t^n in the actual power series ring.

name: ArithmeticThetaTateSeries.partialX
docstring: r=0 plus the two tails for 1≤r≤N, including the normalization correction.

name: ArithmeticThetaTateSeries.tateX
docstring: Stable coefficient candidates; stabilization is a new theorem obligation.

name: ArithmeticThetaTateSeries.xTerm
docstring: v/(1-v)^2, using the formal power-series inverse.

name: ArithmeticThetaTensorPower.tensorPower
docstring:
Iterated genuine sheaf tensor, starting with the structure sheaf.
The exponent-one identification is the accepted genuine left unit isomorphism.

name: ArithmeticThetaTensorPower.tensorPowerSection
docstring: Actual tensor power of a section; it does not refer to a chosen local frame.
